category.title: AEO Tools, Build Stacks & Agencies
category.subtitle: How to choose your answer-engine strategy: Buy, Build, or Hire. The players, how to read them, kept current.

method.scores: Presence / Velocity / Agent-Readiness, set by Adam, refreshed weekly, relative across the tracked set. Each carries a short reason.
method.ai_visibility: Weekly run of buyer-intent queries across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude; counts are how often each vendor is named in web-grounded answers. Latest run: 2026-08-23.

entities.name: Open Source AEO Projects & Resources
entities.summary: The open-source side of AEO/GEO is moving fast. This is the curated landscape — skill packs, frameworks, trackers, publisher-side tooling, and the academic work — for teams that want to build rather than buy. Star counts are a rough proxy for traction, not quality; pick on fit and license.

entities.name: Ahrefs
entities.summary: Bootstrapped, Singapore-based SEO platform extending into AEO from its own web crawler. Customers include IBM, LinkedIn, Uber, Adidas, and Shopify. No outside funding. Recent releases: the Letaido agent workspace, doubled API and MCP limits on all plans, and an Adaptive traffic model that accounts for AI Overviews.

presence.why: ~$149M rev, bootstrapped, dominant SEO; AEO bolt-on

velocity.why: Steady; AEO is strong add-on not core focus

agent_readiness.why: Official MCP plus mature API

entities.name: AirOps
entities.summary: AirOps is an AEO content operations platform for marketing teams, used by Webflow and Chime. It has raised $62.5M and was valued at $225M, with recent launches including AI Ads, AirOps Services, and Quill.

presence.why: $62M raised, $225M val, Ramp/Wiz/Klaviyo logos; native AEO

velocity.why: Headcount 20→100 in a year; fresh Series B

agent_readiness.why: Official MCP + Claude Connector, REST API, Client SDK

entities.name: AIVO
entities.summary: Decision-stage AI-answer measurement platform that scores whether a brand survives to the final purchase recommendation, not just whether it shows up. Coined the category "Agentic Brand Control" and the metric Conversational Survival Rate. Runs multi-turn buying-sequence probes across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok. Founder commentary featured in Fortune (Jan 2026). Funding and cust

velocity.why: Active publish/ship cadence — AIVO Optimize, AIVO Edge, and the Agentic Brand Control category paper all May 2026

agent_readiness.why: No API/MCP/SDK/CLI product surface; only a public spec repo for the AIVO Standard

entities.name: Amplitude
entities.summary: Public product-analytics platform (NASDAQ: AMPL) extending into AI visibility. The classic Amplitude Analytics, Experiment, and Session Replay suite now sits alongside AI Visibility, a visibility score across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude. The wedge that no pure-play has: AI mentions wire straight into Amplitude's analytics graph, so a visibility score lands next to the traffic,

entities.name: Amsive
entities.summary: Full-service performance marketing agency and home of Lily Ray, VP of SEO & AI Search and one of the most recognized figures in SEO and AEO. In June 2025 Amsive formally expanded its search practice with an Answer Engine Optimization offering aimed at brands navigating AI search, leaning on a search team of more than 35 specialists.

entities.name: Animalz
entities.summary: Content marketing agency for enterprise SaaS, known for expert-interview-driven editorial, now running an AEO program. Engagements start with an AEO audit that benchmarks a brand's AI visibility against competitors and produces a 90-day execution roadmap.

entities.name: AthenaHQ
entities.summary: AEO/GEO measurement and remediation platform for brand teams, tracking what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini say about a company and then changing it. Customers include Coinbase, SoFi, Slalom, and Hearst. About $2.7M raised. Recent releases: Ask Athena copilot, the Athena Citation Engine, and Oracle.

presence.why: Punches above $2.7M seed on influencer visibility

velocity.why: Shipping cadence cooled recently; smaller team

agent_readiness.why: Some API access; no public MCP yet

entities.name: Bluefish AI
entities.summary: Enterprise AEO/GEO platform focused on brand visibility and the accuracy of AI answers. Customers include American Express, Adidas, LVMH, and Ulta Beauty. $68M raised. Recent releases: a Bazaarvoice review partnership, Agentic Campaigns workflow automation, and AI Accuracy claim verification.

presence.why: $68M raised, $43M Series B, F500 logos; invisible socially

entities.name: Botify
entities.summary: Enterprise SEO platform refitted for AEO/GEO, serving The New York Times, Levi's, Sephora, and Carrefour. It has raised $82M and recently launched AgenticCatalog, PageWorkers at Edge, and product-card tracking in AI Visibility.

presence.why: ~$82M, 500+ brands, Forrester Strong Performer

agent_readiness.why: API + MCP + llms.txt — strong agent stack

entities.name: Brandlight

Customers include Kimberly-Clark, Estée Lauder, LG, and The Hartford. $30M Series A led by Pelion in Feb 2026 (~$35.75M total). entities.name: BrightEdge
entities.summary: Enterprise SEO platform, founded 2007, retrofitting its search-data stack for AEO/GEO. Serves 57% of the Fortune 500, with customers including Kantar, Belron, Persimmon, and Telstra. $63.9M raised. Recent releases: AI Hyper Cube, AI Agent Insights, Share of Voice V2, and the AI Early Detection System.

presence.why: ~$120M ARR, 57% of F500; corpus SOV gap

velocity.why: Real AEO line but slow legacy-platform cadence

agent_readiness.why: Enterprise APIs but no agent-native surface

entities.name: Clay
entities.summary: GTM data and agent workflow platform built for GTM engineers, used by Anthropic, OpenAI, and Stripe. Raised a $115M Series D at a $7.1B valuation in September 2026. Recent releases: the API, CLI, and Agent Plugin, an email Sequencer, and Workflows.

presence.why: $5B val, $100M+ ARR, 14k customers — ubiquitous GTM product

velocity.why: Relentless shipping cadence; close behind Profound

agent_readiness.why: Deep API, integrations, agentic enrichment surfaces

entities.name: Conductor
entities.summary: Enterprise SEO and content-intelligence platform repositioned around AEO, serving Airbnb and Coca-Cola. Founded in 2010 with $210M in total funding, Conductor recently launched Ask Conductor, its Content API, and Pages Report.

presence.why: $210M, 16yr enterprise platform, Forrester Leader

agent_readiness.why: AgentStack AEO new; enterprise integrations but thin agent surface

entities.summary: daydream is an AI-native SEO and AEO agency serving companies including Clay and Twingate. It has raised $21M and recently launched the autonomous Sunbeam product, expanded its full-spectrum V2.0 service, and added AI search monitoring through Scrunch AI.

entities.name: Demand-Genius

The classic PR, social-listening, and influencer suite now sits alongside GenAI Lens, an AI-visibility tracker across 7 platforms, and Mira, the AI assistant layer. Recent moves: GenAI Lens launch,

entities.name: Noble
entities.summary: The earned-media and source-acquisition layer for AEO. Noble finds the prompts where a brand is absent from AI answers, contacts the third-party publishers the LLMs actually cite, and negotiates placements it calls "Mention Offers." It's the activation arm that monitoring tools plug into — a different slot in the stack than a tracker. Company details (founder, funding, headcount) are undisclosed.

entities.name: Notebook Agency
entities.summary: Founder-led boutique SEO/GEO shop for B2B SaaS, founded 2019 and run by Steve Toth, creator of the SEO Notebook and AI Notebook newsletters (27K+ combined subscribers). Frames the shift bluntly — "AEO is eating SEO" — and brings that point of view to a small, senior team rather than a monitoring tool.

entities.name: Obility
entities.summary: B2B digital marketing agency for hyper-growth tech and SaaS companies, founded in 2011 by Mike Nierengarten and based in Portland, OR. Obility positions on pipeline and revenue rather than traffic, and runs a branded Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) service framed as complementary to SEO rather than a replacement.

entities.name: OtterlyAI
entities.summary: Self-serve AEO/GEO monitoring and optimization platform used by BenQ, Stella Rising, and RDA. Bootstrapped since 2024, OtterlyAI recently shipped Agent Analytics, redesigned citation reporting, and write endpoints for its REST API and MCP server.

presence.why: Bootstrapped category floor ($29/mo), Gartner Cool Vendor

velocity.why: Decent cadence for solo-scale tool

agent_readiness.why: Consume-only; no agent surfaces

velocity.why: Fast specialist shipping; capable MCP recently added

agent_readiness.why: Capable MCP server plus monitoring API

velocity.why: Active comparison-page output and a $99/site self-serve launch; not yet a steady dated release cadence

entities.name: Profound
entities.summary: Full-suite AEO/GEO platform, enterprise-focused. Customers include Snap, Coinbase, Figma, and Expedia. $155M raised at a roughly $1B valuation. Recent releases: Agent Analytics benchmarking, OpenAI Ads nodes, and a 2026 roadmap of always-on Background Agents.

entities.summary: Quattr is an AI-native search visibility platform that unifies SEO, AEO, and GEO into one workflow for mid-market and enterprise brands. Customers cited include Realtor.com, Housing.com, and McAfee. Roughly $7.1M raised. Recent releases: the GIGA execution agent, a GIGA Landing Page Generator, and an Autonomous Internal Linking API.

entities.name: Scrunch AI
entities.summary: AI customer experience platform for AEO/GEO, spanning measurement and delivery. Customers include Lenovo, Crunchbase, and RunPod. Seer runs GEO/AEO inside a broader modern-search practice spanning SEO, paid media, analytics, and CRO, backed by a ~15-person AI R&D team building since January 2023.

entities.name: Semrush (Enterprise AIO)

The classic Semrush keyword, backlink, and rank suite now sits alongside Enterprise AI Optimization (AIO) and the AI Visibility Index, an industry benchmark built on AIO data.
